title: SCE 1.3 — Reactive: Detect and Respond to Malicious CodeBuild Project Creation
description: Validates that an EventBridge + Lambda reactive control detects the creation of a malicious AWS CodeBuild project (attack node 1.2), automatically deletes it, and publishes verifiable CloudWatch metric evidence that the reactor fired. The experiment deploys a dedicated CloudFormation stack, executes the attack by calling codebuild:CreateProject with a credential-exfiltration buildspec, invokes the reactor Lambda, and confirms the defensive response via CloudWatch metric statistics and project-deletion checks.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: Reactive control infrastructure is deployed and the malicious CodeBuild project does not exist prior to the attack
